title: The cousin who gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet
summary: Laurent says his cousin, in charge of boys at the Home, gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet, and mentions a violinist cousin.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Same way with Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong was in the home. My cousin gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet in the home. He was in charge of the boys out there. And he gave Louis Armstrong, Trump started Louis with trumpet. Now who is that?
Was that Peter Davis or another man? It was a man that died last year, two years ago.
No, this fellow Ben did, what I'm talking about, he was a valto.
Oh, no. Is that related to the violin player?
Charlie Valto, yeah. That's my first cousin, Charlie. Same name as the violin player.
Same name as the violin player.

Same name. He was a valto. Now I had another fellow, a cousin of mine, he was an old age of a man, Amarjan they used to call him in French, Amarjan. He was a great violinist too. Oh, he had loved violin. He could play violin.
